text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Acme POC stuck. They can call the hosted API fine but when we stand up their Dedicated VPC pool the SCIM sync fails and SAML assertions are getting rejected. Need help triaging asap.
ida-se: Can you paste the SCIM error and the SAML response? Also which Dedicated pool region/agent are they on?
maria-sales: Thanks. Region is eu-west-1 dedicated-pool-3. SCIM error from their IdP: 403 forbidden when we call `/scim/v2/Users`. Also they see `invalid_saml_response` for the ACS redirect after login.
chris-acme: Adding our IdP admin — the 403 started after we rotated the SCIM token this morning. SAML used to work last week.
devon-eng: @chris-acme do you have the exact Authorization header your IdP is sending for SCIM? Often token scope or header format (Bearer vs Token) causes 403 from our gate.
chris-acme: Header looks like `Authorization: Bearer XXXXXX` and we included `scim:write` scope when rotating.
devon-eng: Hmm. On Dedicated Private we validate both token and the source IP against the assigned VPC egress. If their SCIM call is coming from the IdP side it should be allowed — can you confirm the call originates from your SCIM relay in the same region?
chris-acme: Yes, it's from our hosted SCIM service in eu-west-1. We tested curl from that host and it fails.
kelly-sre: Two quick checks: 1) Are you hitting the dedicated endpoint host (dedicated-pool-3.scim.redwood-inference.private) or the public hosted path? 2) Any recent ACL changes on your side?
maria-sales: They were pointed to the public host initially. We switched them to the dedicated private host yesterday after onboarding instructions but maybe the token was minted for the public API scope.
raj-security: If the token was minted for the hosted API client_id it will be rejected by the dedicated tenant gate. Tokens are tenant-scoped. Also SAML rejections often correlate: if our ACS URL in the SP metadata doesn't match what the IdP sends (trailing slash or host mismatch) the assertion will be rejected with `DestinationMismatch`.
ida-se: Can someone paste the SAML Response error payload from their logs? The SAML error message usually contains the reason.
onboarding-bot: Provision attempt 2024-11-05T12:01:33Z — SCIM call `PUT /scim/v2/Users/chr_123` -> 403 {"error":"permission_denied","detail":"token_scope_mismatch"}
onboarding-bot: Provision attempt 2024-11-05T12:03:09Z — SAML response processed -> rejected {"reason":"DestinationMismatch","expected":"https://dedicated-pool-3.auth.redwood-inference.private/saml/acs","received":"https://dedicated-pool-3.auth.redwood-inference.private/saml/acs/"}
devon-eng: Ok that aligns. Token scope mismatch for SCIM and the IdP is sending ACS with an extra trailing slash. Two fixes: re-issue SCIM token scoped to the dedicated tenant (we can do this from Console or the dedicated admin API) and update their SP metadata to use the exact ACS URL without trailing slash (or we can accept both by adding a normalized accept rule for this POC).
chris-acme: We'd prefer not to reconfigure the IdP if we can avoid it while POC is running — can Redwood accept the trailing slash for now?
elly: (typo message) ignore
kelly-sre: We can create a one-off normalized ACS acceptor for this dedicated tenant for the duration of the POC. Need @maria-sales to approve and confirm timeframe. Note this is a temporary relaxation and we'll log the change.
maria-sales: Approve — set for 72 hours. Also please issue a new SCIM token scoped to `tenant:dedicated-pool-3:scim` and paste it in the secure message to Chris.
devon-eng: Will do. Steps I'm taking: 1) Create tenant-scoped SCIM token and send via secure channel. 2) Add normalized ACS rule to accept trailing slash for dedicated-pool-3 for 72h and enable audit logging. 3) Re-run provisioning tests and share logs.
devon-eng: SCIM token created and delivered to Chris via secure vault (confirmed). Normalized ACS rule deployed to tenant at 2024-11-05T12:18:00Z.
onboarding-bot: Provision attempt 2024-11-05T12:19:40Z — SCIM `PUT /scim/v2/Users/chr_123` -> 200 OK
onboarding-bot: Provision attempt 2024-11-05T12:20:03Z — SAML response processed -> success {"user":"chris.acme@example.com","auth_time":"2024-11-05T12:19:59Z"}
chris-acme: Confirmed — users now provision and SAML login works. Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround. :tada: 
maria-sales: Great. Follow-ups: I'll update ticket with temp acceptance note and request Acme to update their SP metadata to canonical ACS (no trailing slash) before the 72h window ends. Also confirm we'll rotate the temporary token and remove the normalization rule after POC.
raj-security: We'll schedule token rotation and normalization rule removal in 72h. Adding audit entries.
ida-se: Marking this POC as unblocked for provisioning — moving to next steps (load test + cost estimate).
